institution: Kerala Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Network (KARS-NET), Department of Health Services, Kerala
period: January to May 2026 (printed "2026 till MAY"), with yearly comparison for 2023 to 2025
citation: Kerala Health Team. Antimicrobial resistance profile of Shigella isolates based on KARSNET data. Thiruvananthapuram: Department of Health Services, Government of Kerala; 2026.
reporting: Percent resistant of Shigella isolates to six antibiotics by year (2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 up to May) from KARS-Net data, with the number of isolates per year; a line chart with a data table (image). Antibiotic-year combinations with fewer than 30 isolates tested are named in a footnote.
method: KARS-Net laboratory surveillance data; the note does not describe testing methods or breakpoints.

verification.note: The chart and its data table are an embedded image with no text layer: values read from page images (the image extracted at its native 1014 x 824 px and the table zoomed), every 2026 value checked against the chart's line labels, and the 2023 to 2025 columns checked against the KARS-Net annual reports for those years (same values). The small-numbers footnote is in the text layer.

notes: Outbreak report, not a cumulative antibiogram: a 3-page Kerala Health note on the 2026 Shigella outbreak in Kerala (226 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 deaths reported by 22 June 2026, more than the 133 cases of all of 2025), giving KARS-Net resistance figures for the 44 Shigella isolates of January to May 2026 and for the three previous years. The 2026 figures are part-year, outbreak-period data from few isolates (ampicillin 29 tested, chloramphenicol fewer than 30); they come from the outbreak period and may differ from sporadic shigellosis. All figures are percent resistant. The note's treatment advice (ciprofloxacin no longer suitable empirically; carbapenem first for shock or multi-organ dysfunction, ceftriaxone for other inpatients, cefixime or azithromycin, or co-trimoxazole or doxycycline, for outpatients) is not recorded as data.
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 5 cells, n (44), the ampicillin number tested (29) and every trend point re-read blind from the chart's data table (embedded image extracted at 1014 x 824 px) and checked against the line labels: 0 errors, nothing corrected. The 2023 column agrees with KARS-Net 2023 Table 9 (ampicillin 42%, ciprofloxacin 91%, azithromycin 25%, co-trimoxazole 25%).
Second reader: added the printed isolate total (2026 till May, N=44) as a count, under the row's specimen (stool).
Lead 2026-09-26: an outbreak series, not a cumulative antibiogram: given a focus (shown, never pooled, never a profile) and its own institution key.
